arms.advised_ensemble: NEW: ensemble adviser, 119 runs, identical scenarios/seeds
arms.advised_single: frozen v2 single-model adviser results (119 runs)

authority_boundary: HMC remains sole actuator authority in every arm. The adviser only proposes; abstention on unavailable telemetry is unchanged.
determinism_guard: Before the ensemble campaign, a smoke run repeats one v2 scenario control arm twice and requires identical integrated_exceedance to the frozen v2 record.

members.training_split: frozen outer-train only; 17 outer-held-out clusters untouched in training

motivation: Five-member action-aware ensemble scored NMAE 0.1049 on the frozen outer holdout vs 0.1146 for the single base model, and member disagreement correlates with error (Pearson r = 0.653, ensemble_eval.json). This campaign tests whether penalizing candidate actions by forecast disagreement improves closed-loop outcomes versus the v2 single-model adviser.
primary_success_criteria: P1: ensemble arm is never worse than BOTH control and single-model arms in any scenario (no dominated regression)
P2: ensemble arm beats or ties the single-model arm's paired record vs control (v2 record: 78 better / 24 equal / 0 worse on fault pairs)

roster.name: v2 (identical scenario configs and seeds as preregistration-v2)
roster.scenarios: 17 held-out clusters x members T01/T07/T12 x repetitions R01/R02, plus 17 healthy R01
roster.seed_note: nonce and noise seeds derive deterministically from the same design anchors; control and single-model arms are the frozen v2 results, not re-run

scoring_rule.disagreement_definition: mean over the [8,51] target grid of (std across 5 members / target_std), NaN-safe
scoring_rule.lambda_derivation: From frozen-holdout disagreement stats (mean 0.0546, p95 0.0999): typical risk inflation ~11%, p95 ~20%. Penalty is proportional to the candidate's own predicted risk, so uncertainty only reorders candidates when predicted risk is nonzero. No ensemble closed-loop outcome was observed before freezing.
scoring_rule.tie_break: earliest candidate in frozen design order (identical to v2)

secondary_measures: resource deltas (battery Wh, oxygen mol, sorbent mol) vs single-model arm
healthy no-harm rate (v2: 16/17 zero-exceedance, one 0.038 case)
disagreement penalty firing statistics (how often ranking changed vs unpenalized)
status: development evidence only; not qualification, deployment, or safety proof
title: Ensemble adviser with disagreement-penalized risk ranking
